title: FOMO samplesheet schema
description: Schema for the FOMO pipeline samplesheet

species.errorMessage: Species name must be a non-empty string with no spaces

role.errorMessage: Role must be 'source' (donor only), 'target' (projected onto, not a donor; an optional gff3 is used only as the curation reference), or 'both' (donor and target, benchmarked against its own annotation — the all-vs-all case)

fasta.errorMessage: FASTA file must exist and end in .fa, .fasta, or .fna (optionally .gz)

gff3.errorMessage: GFF3 file must exist and end in .gff or .gff3 (optionally .gz)

then.errorMessage: A row with role 'source' or 'both' donates its annotation and MUST have a gff3. A pure 'target' may leave it empty, or give its own annotation to be used as the curation reference only (filter overlapping models, tag the nearest reference gene, merged output) — it is not benchmarked; use role 'both' for that, which also makes it a donor.
